definitions.explanation: A calendar year or a period of one year. 今年 (this year), 来年 (next year).
A person's age. 年を取る (to age), 年上 (older).

examples.japanese: 年を聞いてもいいですか。

examples.english: It's getting hotter year by year.
examples.notes: 年々 (ねんねん) = year by year

notes: 年 has two main readings: とし (standalone, meaning year or age) and ねん (in compounds and as a counter: 三年 = 3 years, 2024年 = year 2024). The counter 〜年 for duration uses ねん: 一年間 (one year period).
